title: Say when you are available
name: Time and dates
syntax: Ich komme am Montag um 14 Uhr.
summary: Arrange ordinary plans without complex grammar.
rule: Memorize these time chunks: heute, morgen, am Montag, um 14 Uhr, nächste Woche.
examples: Ich habe um 15 Uhr einen Termin.
I have an appointment at 3 p.m.
avoid: Within a sentence, Morgen (capitalized) means morning; morgen (lowercase) means tomorrow. At the start of a sentence, both begin with a capital M.
note: am + weekday; um + clock time; im + month: im November.
